item.headline: Republicans Debate Why They Lost the Midterms, and if Trump Is to Blame
item.summary: A divide is emerging in the party over what caused its wipeout midterm defeats, foreshadowing a battle over how to move forward before 2028.
item.author: Bayliss Wagner

reads.result: Republicans are split over why they lost the midterms so badly and whether Trump is to blame, setting up a fight ahead of 2028.
